(ONLY reruns those probes; EXTRA appends a directory to every probe's package path, CPython's and Pystachy's)
setup downloads each probe's pinned sdist (SHA-256 checked) into WORK/upstream/<package>/ and installs the
reference dependencies (and numpy/pandas, which the original probes read from installed wheels) with
pip --no-deps --target WORK/deps at the recorded versions. run compiles each probe with CHECKOUT's
CPython-hosted compiler (pystachy ir), in two configurations: the original one (package root and WORK/deps
on PYSTACHY_PATH, the shipped lib/ as fallback, no CPython stdlib) and the same with OVERLAY (a pristine
CPython 3.13.16 stdlib from tools/import_sweep.py --overlay) appended. It also runs each probe on CPython
with the same package path, for the reference result.
"""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile
import tempfile
import time
import urllib.request
import zipfile

ROOT = "/home/user/pystachy"
EVIDENCE = json.load(open(os.path.join(ROOT, "docs/reports/compatibility-2026-10-17-packages.json")))
PROBES = EVIDENCE["upstream_probes"]
WHEEL_ONLY = {"numpy": "2.3.5", "pandas": "2.2.3"}  # (installed-wheel probes in the original audit)


def setup(work):
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(work, "upstream"), exist_ok=True)
    for p in PROBES:
        if "source" not in p:
            continue
        dest = os.path.join(work, "upstream", p["package"])
        archive = os.path.join(work, p["filename"])
        if not os.path.exists(archive):
            urllib.request.urlretrieve(p["source"], archive)
        got = hashlib.sha256(open(archive, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
        if got != p["sha256"]:
            raise SystemExit(f"{p['filename']}: SHA-256 {got}, expected {p['sha256']}")
        if not os.path.isdir(dest):
            os.makedirs(dest)
            if archive.endswith(".zip"):
                zipfile.ZipFile(archive).extractall(dest)
            else:
                tarfile.open(archive).extractall(dest, filter="data")
        print("ok", p["filename"])
    deps = [f"{d['name']}=={d['version']}" for d in EVIDENCE["reference_dependencies"]]
    deps += [f"{k}=={v}" for k, v in WHEEL_ONLY.items()]
    subprocess.run(["uv", "pip", "install", "--quiet", "--no-deps", "--python", sys.executable,
                    "--target", os.path.join(work, "deps")] + deps, check=True)


def module_root(work, p):
    root = p["module_root"]
    if root.startswith("build/audit-packages/upstream/"):
        return os.path.join(work, "upstream", root[len("build/audit-packages/upstream/"):])
    return os.path.join(work, "deps")  # (click, numpy, pandas: installed upstream wheel sources)


def run(work, checkout, overlay, out):
    results = []
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="package-probes-") as tmp:
        only = os.environ.get("ONLY", "").split(",") if os.environ.get("ONLY") else None
        extra = [os.environ["EXTRA"]] if os.environ.get("EXTRA") else []
        for p in PROBES:
            if only is not None and p["package"] not in only:
                continue
            prog = os.path.join(tmp, f"probe_{p['package'].replace('-', '_')}.py")
            open(prog, "w").write(p["program"])
            base = [module_root(work, p), os.path.join(work, "deps")] + extra
            row = {"package": p["package"], "version": p["version"], "program": p["program"],
                   "previous_error": p.get("ir_error", "").strip().splitlines()[0] if p.get("ir_error") else ""}
            env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=":".join(base))
            r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", prog] if False else [sys.executable, prog], cwd=tmp, env=env,
                               capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
            row["cpython_exit"] = r.returncode
            row["cpython_output"] = r.stdout[-300:]
            for config, paths in [("shipped_lib", base), ("stdlib_overlay", base + [overlay])]:
                env = dict(os.environ)
                env["PYSTACHY_PATH"] = ":".join(paths)
                env.pop("PYSTACHY_HOME", None)
                t0 = time.monotonic()
                r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "pystachy", "ir", prog, "-o", os.devnull], cwd=checkout,
                                   env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=1800)
                msg = (r.stdout + r.stderr).strip()
                for path, tag in [(tmp + "/", ""), (overlay + "/", "<stdlib>/"), (work + "/", "<pkgs>/"),
                                  (checkout + "/", "<checkout>/")]:
                    msg = msg.replace(path, tag)
                row[config] = {"exit": r.returncode, "first_error": msg.splitlines()[0] if msg else "",
                               "seconds": round(time.monotonic() - t0, 3)}
            results.append(row)
            print(p["package"], row["cpython_exit"], "|", row["shipped_lib"]["first_error"][:150], "|",
                  row["stdlib_overlay"]["first_error"][:150])
    json.dump({"checkout": checkout, "overlay": overlay, "python": sys.version, "extra": extra, "probes": results},
              open(out, "w"), indent=1)


if sys.argv[1] == "setup":
    setup(sys.argv[2])
else:
    run(*sys.argv[2:6])
